name: Exp_Kolier_SuperTrend
summary: This EA trades based on the Kolier SuperTrend indicator, opening buy positions on upward trend signals and sell positions on downward trend signals. It uses ATR-based trend detection with configurable multiplier and period, applying fixed stop loss and take profit levels. The EA operates on a new bar basis and includes permission switches for buying, selling, and position closing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Kolier SuperTrend指标进行交易，在上升趋势信号时开多仓，在下降趋势信号时开空仓。使用基于ATR的趋势检测，具有可配置的乘数和周期，并应用固定的止损止盈水平。EA以新K线为基础运行，包含买卖和仓位平仓的权限开关。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于SuperTrend指标的趋势跟踪，利用ATR乘数动态确定趋势方向。入场条件为：当UpSignal信号触发时开多仓，当DnSignal信号触发时开空仓，且需要对应权限开关开启。出场条件包括：反向SuperTrend信号触发时平仓（如UpTrend持续时平空仓，DnTrend持续时平多仓），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数，由TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数实现。资金管理方面，EA没有动态调整止损止盈的逻辑，也没有根据波动率自适应调整仓位大小的机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但过度依赖单一指标且缺乏过滤条件可能导致频繁假信号交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is trend following based on the SuperTrend indicator, which dynamically determines trend direction using ATR with a configurable multiplier. Entry conditions are: open a long position when UpSignal triggers and open a short position when DnSignal triggers, provided the corresponding permission switches are enabled. Exit conditions include closing positions on opposing SuperTrend signals (e.g., closing shorts when UpTrend persists, closing longs when DnTrend persists), plus fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit share-based sizing, implemented via the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment of stop loss/take profit and has no volatility-adaptive position sizing mechanism. The overall strategy logic is clear, but over-reliance on a single indicator without additional filters may lead to frequent trades on false signals in ranging markets.

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，基于成熟的SuperTrend趋势跟踪指标
提供买卖权限开关，灵活性高，可单独启用多头或空头交易
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易
使用ATR动态确定趋势带宽度，能适应不同波动率环境
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, based on the well-established SuperTrend trend-following indicator
Provides buy/sell permission switches for high flexibility, enabling long-only or short-only trading
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar
Uses ATR to dynamically determine trend band width, adapting to different volatility environments
cons: 仅依赖单一指标，缺乏多因子确认或过滤机制，震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号
止损止盈为固定点数，未根据ATR或市场波动率动态调整，可能不适应当前行情
没有回撤控制、最大持仓限制或每日亏损限制等资金管理保护机制
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，代码可读性和可维护性降低
cons_en: Relies solely on a single indicator without multi-factor confirmation or filtering, prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
Stop loss and take profit are fixed point values, not dynamically adjusted based on ATR or market volatility
Lacks drawdown control, maximum position limits, or daily loss limits as money management safeguards
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing code readability and maintainability
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认或多指标过滤（如RSI、MACD），减少震荡市假信号
将止损止盈改为基于ATR动态计算，使风控更适应市场波动率变化
增加最大回撤限制和每日交易次数限制，加强资金管理保护
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicator filters (e.g., RSI, MACD) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Change stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation for better volatility-adapted risk management
Add maximum drawdown limits and daily trade count limits to strengthen money management protection

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不随波动率调整，在高波动期可能止损过小导致频繁被扫
无最大回撤或日亏损限制，极端行情下可能持续亏损
单指标策略在震荡市中可能频繁开平仓产生大量滑点和手续费损失
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adjust with volatility, potentially causing frequent stop-outs during high volatility periods
No maximum drawdown or daily loss limit, which may lead to sustained losses in extreme market conditions
Single-indicator strategy may frequently open and close positions in ranging markets, incurring significant slippage and commission costs
